q: 我嗓子很疼，___今天不想说话。
en: My throat really hurts, so I don't feel like talking today.

q: ___保持身体健康，爷爷每天早上都去公园走路。
en: In order to stay healthy, Grandpa walks in the park every morning.

q: 既然你发烧了，___在家休息吧，别去上班了。
en: Since you have a fever, rest at home and don't go to work.

q: 由于昨天晚上下了大雪，___今天学校放假了。
en: Owing to the heavy snow last night, school is closed today.

q: ___不感冒，孩子们出门前都要多穿一件衣服。
en: In order not to catch a cold, the children put on an extra layer before going out.

q: ___你已经知道自己对花粉过敏，春天就应该少出门。
en: Since you already know you are allergic to pollen, you should go out less in spring.

q: ___气温突然下降，___很多人感冒了。
en: Because the temperature suddenly dropped, many people caught colds.

q: 虽然今天很冷，___我还是想去游泳。
en: Although it is cold today, I still want to go swimming.

q: ___明天天气不好，我们也要去爬山。
en: Even if the weather is bad tomorrow, we are going hiking.

q: 他尽管发着高烧，___坚持把工作做完。
en: Even though he had a high fever, he still insisted on finishing the work.

q: ___医生已经一再提醒他少吃盐，他还是每顿饭都吃得很咸。
en: Even though the doctor has reminded him again and again to eat less salt, he still eats very salty food at every meal.

q: 就算明天下雨，我___要去上班。
en: Even if it rains tomorrow, I still have to go to work.

q: ___他的腿还很疼，___他今天坚持来上课了。
en: Although his leg still hurts, he insisted on coming to class today.

q: 他___每天都按时吃药，病却一直没有好。
en: Although he takes his medicine on time every day, he has not got better.

q: ___明天你的感冒好了，医生也要你再休息两天。
en: Even if your cold is better tomorrow, the doctor still wants you to rest two more days.

q: 如果你头疼，我们___去医院看看。
en: If you have a headache, we will go to the hospital and have a look.

q: 只有每天睡够八个小时，我___有精神。
en: Only if I sleep a full eight hours every day do I feel energetic.

q: 只要不下雨，我们___去公园玩。
en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go to the park to play.

q: 要是你对牛奶过敏的话，早餐___别喝牛奶了。
en: If you are allergic to milk, then don't drink milk at breakfast.

q: 只有医生同意了，他___能出院。
en: Only when the doctor agrees can he leave the hospital.

q: 只要坚持锻炼，你的身体___会慢慢好起来的。
en: As long as you keep exercising, your body will gradually get better.

q: ___夏天一直这么热，我们___得装空调了。
en: If summer stays this hot, we will have to put in an air conditioner.

q: 不管天气怎么样，他每天___去跑步。
en: Whatever the weather is like, he goes running every day.

q: 无论冬天___夏天，奶奶都坚持早起散步。
en: Whether it is winter or summer, Grandma gets up early for a walk.

q: 不管你身体好不好，医生___要你定期检查。
en: Whether or not you are in good health, the doctor wants you to have regular check-ups.

q: 除了星期天，爸爸每天___去医院上班。
en: Dad goes to work at the hospital every day except Sunday.

q: 除了感冒药，医生___给我开了一些维生素。
en: Besides the cold medicine, the doctor also prescribed me some vitamins.

q: 除了我，家里人___喜欢吃辣的。
en: Everyone in my family likes spicy food except me.

q: 不管天气多么热，他___坚持每天跑五公里。
en: No matter how hot the weather is, he keeps running five kilometres every day.

q: 无论医生怎么劝，爷爷___不肯住院。
en: No matter how the doctor urges him, Grandpa refuses to go into hospital.

q: 不管___累，她每天晚上都要锻炼半小时。
en: However tired she is, she exercises for half an hour every night.

q: 除了每天吃药以外，医生___要求他每周去医院检查一次。
en: Besides taking medicine every day, the doctor also requires him to go to the hospital for a check once a week.

q: 不管是感冒___发烧，他都坚持上班。
en: Whether it is a cold or a fever, he still goes to work.

q: 这个西瓜___大又甜，夏天吃最好了。
en: This watermelon is both big and sweet, perfect to eat in summer.

q: 他不但嗓子疼，___还发烧了。
en: Not only does his throat hurt, he also has a fever now.

q: 我喜欢一边听音乐，___做运动。
en: I like to listen to music while I exercise.

q: 这种药既苦，___贵，我不想吃。
en: This medicine is both bitter and expensive, so I don't want to take it.

q: 不但弟弟爱运动，妹妹___常常陪他去跑步。
en: Not only does my brother love sports, my sister often goes jogging with him too.

q: 雨___下___大，我们只好在山下的小店里等着。
en: The rain was falling harder and harder, so we had no choice but to wait in a little shop at the foot of the hill.

q: 天气___冷了，大家都穿上了厚衣服。
en: The weather is getting colder and colder, and everybody has put on thick clothes.

q: 春天来了，白天___来越长了。
en: Spring is here and the days are getting longer and longer.

q: 你越着急，病好得___慢。
en: The more anxious you are, the more slowly you get better.

q: 冬天过去了，天气___暖和，公园里的人也越来越多了。
en: Winter is over, the weather is getting warmer and warmer, and there are more and more people in the park.

q: 这种药你吃得越多，对身体___不好。
en: The more of this medicine you take, the worse it is for your body.

q: 我不是感冒了，___是过敏了。
en: It is not that I have a cold; I have an allergy.

q: 他最近不是咳嗽，___是发烧，一直没好。
en: Lately he is always either coughing or running a fever and has not got better.

q: 周末你自己选：___去爬山，___在家休息。
en: Choose for yourself this weekend: either go hiking or rest at home.

q: 他周末不是看电视，___是睡觉，哪儿也不去。
en: At weekends he is either watching TV or sleeping and goes nowhere.

q: 你想怎么治？___吃药，___打针，你自己决定。
en: How do you want to be treated? Either take medicine or have an injection; it is up to you.

q: 我一回到家，___觉得头疼。
en: As soon as I got home, I felt a headache coming on.

q: 我们先去医院看医生，___去药店买药。
en: We'll first go to the hospital to see a doctor, and then go to the pharmacy to buy the medicine.

q: 一到秋天，北京的天气___变得干燥起来。
en: As soon as autumn arrives, the weather in Beijing starts to turn dry.

q: 你___把手洗干净，再给孩子喂药。
en: First wash your hands clean, then give the child the medicine.
